summary.zh: 英特尔四季度指引远低于预期，盘前暴跌约25%，亚马逊财报后资本开支与自由现金流忧虑再度升温，纳指期货下跌约2.6%，亚欧芯片股普遍重挫。SOXX盘前约-6.8%，但SMH约-5.2%，成分股加权偏小一些，故缺口取-6.3%。开盘后大跌缺口历史上略有回落，摩根士丹利仍提示继续下行风险，开盘后再取-0.3%。
summary.en: Intel's weak Q4 guidance (shares about -25% pre-market) and Amazon's capex and free-cash-flow worries pushed Nasdaq futures down about 2.6% and hit chips in Asia and Europe. SOXX is about -6.8% pre-market but SMH about -5.2%, so I take a -6.3% gap. Large gaps have tended to fade slightly lower after the open and Morgan Stanley warns of more downside, so drift is -0.3.

factors.zh: 英特尔盘前约-25%，指引不及预期；AMD约-8.5%
factors.en: Intel about -25% pre-market on weak guidance; AMD about -8.5%

factors.zh: 亚马逊盘前约-6.7%，AI资本开支回报忧虑；纳指期货约-2.6%
factors.en: Amazon about -6.7% pre-market on AI capex worries; Nasdaq futures about -2.6%

factors.zh: 亚欧芯片股重挫：SK海力士-7.1%、东京电子-5.2%、阿斯麦(阿姆斯特丹)-5.6%
factors.en: Asia and Europe chips sold off: SK Hynix -7.1%, Tokyo Electron -5.2%, ASML Amsterdam -5.6%

factors.zh: SOXX约-6.8%但SMH约-5.2%，英伟达仅约-2.5%，缺口取-6.3%
factors.en: SOXX about -6.8% vs SMH about -5.2%, Nvidia only about -2.5%; gap set at -6.3%

factors.zh: 基础比率：大跌缺口收盘后平均再回落约0.4%；RSI 36，超卖有限
factors.en: Base rate: gaps beyond -3% average about -0.4% more after the open; RSI 36, only mildly oversold

risk.zh: 若英特尔跌幅收窄、英伟达和博通企稳，抄底买盘可能令指数收复部分缺口，实际跌幅小于预测；反之AI担忧升级则可能跌得更深。
risk.en: If Intel's drop narrows and Nvidia and Broadcom stabilize, dip buying could recover part of the gap and the fall ends smaller; if AI-spending fears escalate, it could be deeper.

views.en: Says the market correction is in its final innings, but chip stocks could still fall up to 15% more before finding support.
views.zh: 认为市场调整已近尾声，但芯片股在企稳前仍可能再跌最多15%。

views.en: Downgraded Intel to Neutral and cut his price target to $100 from $145 after the weak guidance.
views.zh: 在英特尔指引疲弱后，将其评级下调至中性，目标价由145美元降至100美元。

views.en: Reports Amazon down about 7% and Intel down about 25% pre-market as weak earnings deepen AI-spending concerns.
views.zh: 报道称亚马逊盘前跌约7%、英特尔跌约25%，财报疲弱加深市场对AI支出的担忧。
